title: 第21章 普贤叫嚣无人战万载玄盾对金莲第22章 万载硬钢混沌雷破损金莲赠林镜
slug: 洪荒我怎么变成混沌至宝了
content_zh:
在场众仙都看得出来，元始天尊的心情十分不悦！
毕竟他们阐教浩浩荡荡前来金鳌岛，可不是为了来送先天灵宝的！
本来这第一局让慈航道人上场是十拿九稳的局面，没想到竟然遇上了集齐全部定海神珠的赵公明！
慈航道人脸色也十分难看，出门一趟没有捞到好处，反而把自己最珍贵的灵宝丢了！
眼见师尊不悦，文殊广法天尊赶紧站了出来直接出战！
他的七宝金莲已经被师尊提前强化了一番，如今不仅专克各种灵宝，而且其中蕴含一道恐怖的混沌雷霆！只要不是先天至宝，最基本都扛不住！
看来这截教第一件灵宝还是得归我文殊所有啊！
而此时的林镜早就看到了文殊的底牌，开始观察适合对战的师兄弟！
这混沌雷霆的确不好对付，寻常先天灵宝被打到恐怕也会损伤不小！
不过这混沌雷霆只有一道，属于一次性消耗品！
林镜的目光从各位师兄师姐身上扫去……
云霄师姐不行，混元金斗的作用大部分是针对修士的！
金灵师姐也不行，龙虎如意主攻，防御力不太行！
龟灵师姐嘛，这伴生灵宝万载玄盾，防御力不错，可惜没有攻击力啊！
咦？这个好像能抗住混沌雷霆啊！
林镜的目光再一次锁定在龟灵圣母的身上，那宝光的气息也越发明显！
【万载玄盾】:伴生灵宝（等同先天灵宝）。以万载灵龟化形之时以自身躯壳转化的灵宝，防御至宝！可承受三次圣人之威而不灭！但无任何攻击手段！（可强化！）
不过如今积分都掏空了，强化不了啊！
林镜把目光看向了手中刚刚得来的灵宝......
没想到这清净琉璃瓶之中，竟然还剩余2000多滴三光神水！

更让他没想到的是灵宝系统的提示！
【叮！检测到宿主获得三光神水！可消耗800滴三光神水兑换1600积分！】
林镜想都没想，直接就选择了兑换！
这三光神水早晚还能获得，现在清净琉璃瓶在手，还怕没有三光神水喝嘛！
不过林镜看来多位师兄弟的各种灵宝，似乎现在只有这件【万载玄盾】达到了强化的条件！
于是他邀请了龟灵圣母来到偏殿……
“龟灵师姐，能不能借你的伴生灵宝一观！”
龟灵圣母倒是十分豪爽，随手一挥就把万载玄盾丢了出来！
“拿去看吧！随便整，反正也玩不坏！不过我这灵宝可只能防御哦！虽然防御力很强，但是仅仅是灵宝对战的话，只能做到不败而已！”
林镜准备双手抬起面前的万载玄盾，可惜根本举不动！
这截教就是重感情啊，伴生灵宝这么贵重的东西随随便便就拿出来了！
content_en:
All the immortals present could see that Yuanshi Tianzun was in a very unhappy mood!
After all, the reason why they came to Jin'ao Island in great force was not to send innate spiritual treasures!
Originally, it was a sure bet to have Taoist Cihang play in the first round, but unexpectedly, he met Zhao Gongming who had collected all the Dinghai Divine Pearls!
Taoist Cihang's face was also very ugly. He didn't get any benefits from his trip, but instead lost his most precious spiritual treasure!
Seeing that Master was displeased, Manjusri Guangfa Tianzun quickly stood up and went straight to fight!
His Seven Treasures Golden Lotus has been strengthened in advance by his master. Now it not only can defeat various spiritual treasures, but also contains a terrifying chaotic thunder! As long as it is not an innate treasure, it is basically impossible to hold it!
It seems that this first spiritual treasure of Jiejiao still belongs to me, Manjusri!
At this time, Lin Jing had already seen Manjusri's trump card and began to observe the brothers who were suitable for the battle!
This Chaos Thunder is indeed difficult to deal with. If an ordinary innate spirit treasure is hit, it will probably be damaged a lot!
However, there is only one Chaos Thunder, and it is a one-time consumable!
Lin Jing's eyes swept over the senior brothers and sisters...
Senior Sister Yunxiao can't do it. Most of Hunyuan Jindou's functions are aimed at monks!
Senior Sister Jin Ling is not good either. Longhu Ruyi mainly attacks, but her defense is not very good!
Senior Sister Guiling, this accompanying spiritual treasure, the Myriad Shield, has good defensive power, but it’s a pity that it has no offensive power!
Huh? This seems to be able to withstand Chaos Thunder!
Lin Jing's eyes were once again locked on the body of the Holy Mother Turtle Spirit, and the aura of Baoguang became more and more obvious!
【Wanzai Xuanshi】: accompanying spiritual treasure (equivalent to innate spiritual treasure). The spiritual treasure that was transformed from its own body when it transformed into a thousand-year-old turtle, a treasure of defense! It can withstand the power of a saint three times without being destroyed! But there is no means of attack! (Can be strengthened!)
But now that the points are all gone, I can’t strengthen it!
Lin Jing looked at the Lingbao he had just obtained...
Unexpectedly, there were more than 2,000 drops of Three Light Divine Water left in this pure glass bottle!
What he didn't expect even more was the prompt from the Lingbao system!
【bite! The host is detected and the three-light divine water is obtained! You can consume 800 drops of Sanguang Divine Water to redeem 1,600 points! 】
Lin Jing didn't even think about it and just chose to redeem it!
Sooner or later, you will be able to get the Three Lights Divine Water. Now that you have the pure glass bottle in hand, you are afraid that you will not be able to drink the Three Lights Divine Water!
However, it seems to Lin Jing that among the various spiritual treasures of many senior brothers, only this [Ten Thousand Years Mysterious Shield] has met the conditions for strengthening!
So he invited Our Lady of Turtle Spirit to the side hall...
"Senior Sister Guiling, can I borrow your companion spirit treasure to take a look!"
The Holy Mother Turtle Spirit was very bold and threw out the Wanzai Xuan Shield with a wave of her hand!
"Let's take a look! You can adjust it as you like, it won't be bad anyway! But my spirit treasure can only defend! Although its defense is very strong, if it's just a spirit treasure battle, it can only be undefeated!"
Lin Jing prepared to lift the Wanzai Xuan Shield in front of him with both hands, but unfortunately he couldn't lift it at all!
This religion is all about feelings, so they took out something as valuable as a companion spirit treasure casually!
